subject: Tri-lane DST handoff — aligning demo windows for US/EU/APAC
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Holmes <ben.holmes@finvista.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:54:00 -0700
Subject: Tri-lane DST handoff — aligning demo windows for US/EU/APAC

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the interest and for lining up the cross-functional folks on your side. We want to make sure the demo is equally useful for your US, EU and APAC participants, and that means proactively avoiding the upcoming DST mismatch week (US jumps earlier this year than EU).

Quick ask: can you confirm approximate availability bands for each region (local time) so we can propose slots that minimize late nights for everyone? For context, here are the constraints from our side:

- Redwood presenters: Kim (US/PDT): 9:00–13:00 PT preferred; Vivek (EMEA hours): 13:00–18:00 CET available for handoff; Marissa (APAC cover): 10:00–15:00 SGT with flexible evenings.
- We're looking for a 60–75 minute session with a 15 minute Q&A buffer.
- Target week: the week of April 4–8, but if that overlaps the EU DST jump for your team we can shift to the week before/after — prefer to avoid the single-day overlap window when only one region has switched.

Attached: demo-availability-ics.ics (three candidate windows) and a short MAP (MAP-FinVista-v1.pdf) that includes area owners.

Suggested next step: if you can share a rough headcount per region and one preferred day range, I’ll propose three rotating handoff-friendly time slots (US-early, EMEA-mid, APAC-late). If it helps, we can run two 45-minute sessions targeting each region separately.

Best

— Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0172
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP-FinVista-v1.pdf (proposal stub)

Subject: Re: Tri-lane DST handoff — aligning demo windows for US/EU/APAC

Hi Kimberly —

Appreciate the heads up. We have stakeholders across New York (US), London (EU) and Singapore (APAC). Rough counts:
- US (NY): 4 attendees — prefer morning ET
- EU (London): 6 attendees — prefer late morning GMT/BST (note: the UK switches on Apr 5)
- APAC (SG): 3 attendees — prefer late afternoon SGT

The week of Apr 4–8 will be messy for us because UK/EU switch on Monday Apr 5 while the US already switched the prior weekend — our calendars already look inconsistent that week.

Can you propose slots for the weeks of Mar 28–Apr 1 and Apr 11–15 that avoid the single-day mismatch? If not, we can try a split approach (EMEA-only + APAC/US joint) as you suggested.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Holmes
Head of Sales Ops, FinVista

Cc: Ben Holmes <ben.holmes@finvista.com>, Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@finvista.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 02:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Tri-lane DST handoff — aligning demo windows for US/EU/APAC

Kim / team —

Thanks for looping me in. Given Ben's constraint about the Apr 4–8 mismatch week, I suggest we offer two options that are least disruptive:

Option A (single session, rotating presenters):
- Week: Mar 28–Apr 1 (pre-switch)
- Time (UTC): 15:00–16:15 UTC — translates to 08:00–09:15 PT (US), 16:00–17:15 CET (EU), 23:00–00:15 SGT (APAC). This keeps the bulk of the heavier lift in US/EMEA, APAC attends later.

Option B (split sessions, region-specific):
- Week: Apr 11–15 (post-switch stable)
- Session 1 (EMEA-focused): 10:30–11:15 CET — short 45-min deep-dive for London team;
- Session 2 (US/APAC joint): 16:00–17:15 SGT / 05:00–06:15 PT — later for US presenters but easier for APAC; we can rotate presenters so no single person works an extreme overnight.

Operational notes:
- I'll own the EMEA session content and handoff scripting for the joint session; Marissa can cover the APAC-specific integrations.
- Attached MAP has named area owners and a suggested presenter rotation.

Ben — can you confirm which of these two approaches you prefer and give a preferred day within the week (Mon/Tue/Thu typically work best for your execs)? If we pick Option A and Marissa needs a lighter slot, we can move the single session 30 minutes earlier or later.

Cheers,
Vivek
Head of Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com | +44 7700 900123
